note: San Bernardino NF campground in historic Holcomb Valley (the old goldfields) about 5 mi north of Big Bear Lake, on dirt Forest Road 3N16 in pine and juniper. Bear boxes. A host is on site mid-May through October. --Claude
summary: Holcomb Valley (SBNF): 19 first-come sites, $27 (+$8 extra vehicle), vault toilets, no water, open year-round with winter access via Polique Canyon Rd; rec.gov 249733 is info-only (not reservable); phone and website to fix; no RV-suitability statement found.
flags: REC.GOV: facility 249733 'Holcomb Valley Campground' is an information-only listing (search API reservable False; /api/camps/campgrounds/249733 returns 404, no campsites, no Scan&Pay rule visible). It confirms first-come only. Stored reservable false / fcfs always now confirmed manual.

RIG FIT: neither page gives a rig length or says anything about trailers or RVs; access is a graded dirt forest road (3N09 then 3N16, ~4 mi). No 4WD or high-clearance requirement or 'not recommended' statement found. Noting only.
FEES: the FS page contradicts itself on holidays ('Additional Holiday Fee: $10 per night' vs 'Holiday $28'); left nightly_high at 27 and said so in fees.note.
FACILITIES: the FS amenity box says 'Restrooms are not available at this site.', but its description lists vault toilets; wrote vault_toilets true from the description.
